why: Shutterflow desktop-v3 is built screen by screen next to apps/desktop; the editor is 25 files, mostly the WebGL renderer and the edit model, which move almost unchanged. They land first as their own Issue.
what: The editor GL renderer, edit model, stage and session: copies with import-only changes and their tests.
contract: Read basalt-ui docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 6.4, shutterflow docs/decisions/0028-visual-regression-gate.md (no bulk baseline regeneration) and AGENTS.md safety rule 1 (photo inputs are the owner's; never read /Volumes). basalt-ui is pinned exact next.N (the gate's floor, v3-sf-bump in `after`): its docs/recipes and llms.txt are the API truth; never edit package.json or bun.lock. Editor GL is deepRender: the file-level waiver covers it with a reason, counted.
exemplar: The landed v3-sf-shell frame (apps/desktop-v3/src/shell) and the playground exemplars in the basalt-ui repo; old code under apps/desktop/src/features/.
change: Copy gl/{affine,orient,renderer,shaders}, model/** (edit-store, geometry-ops, crop-fit, tone, readouts, load-watchdog, use-committed-geometry, source, view, wire), stage/{overlay,Stage.tsx} and editor-session into apps/desktop-v3 with their tests. Only imports change (apps/desktop stays, so these are copies, not renames). Rule: the app preset passes; the GL files carry one file-level deepRender waiver with a reason. Skill snippet: none.
commits: Shutterflow ships by push to master: conventional, one concern each, no attribution. Never edit node_modules or basalt-ui; a gap is a `friction:` line in the PR body.
proof: hygiene.check is false: the factory cannot run `make check` or `make e2e`. Gate: the app's typecheck, test and build; state e2e and visual runs not-run (owner-run at cutover). `make check-changed` runs only without a package.json, bun.lock or Makefile change (else `make check`): state it not-run then.
acceptance: `bun run --filter @shutterflow/desktop-v3 typecheck`, `... test` and `... build` exit 0
`make check-changed` exits 0 (not-run if package.json, bun.lock or the Makefile changed: `make check` then)

`bun scripts/check-port.ts --all apps/desktop/src/features/editor/gl apps/desktop-v3/src/features/editor/gl` exits 0 (import-only differences; any other changed line carries a `// port:` marker listed in the PR); the same for editor/model and editor/stage
crop-fit, tone, readouts and load-watchdog tests pass; `rg -c 'deepRender' apps/desktop-v3/src/features/editor/gl` shows one waiver per GL file with a reason
out_of_scope: Other screens, shell code, apps/desktop, e2e files (v3-sf-e2e-rekey), src-tauri.
